Food

What comes to the table

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Dishes of the day

Every weekday has its own set of home cooked dishes, from pastitsio to beans or lentils, with something vegan every day.

From the grill

Souvlaki, sheftalia and pork chops. 21 reviews mention the souvlaki, 12 the sheftalia, 10 the pork chop.

Halloumi and salads

Fried halloumi in thin pitta, tzatziki and simple salads you dress yourself with olive oil, lemon and vinegar.

Meze for two

Pork and chicken kebabs, sausages, salads, pitta, tzatziki, hummus, mushrooms and chips, as one guest lists it.

Weekdays and weekends

Fair prices

Where locals eat

In the Stoa Klokkari arcade

Evroulla has served traditional Cypriot food since 1988. It sits in the Stoa Klokkari, an arcade in the old town of Nicosia off Onasagorou Street. Open from 12:00 every day, until 22:30 except on Wednesday afternoons.

What guests say

Three of 631 Google reviews, 485 of them with five stars.

“Authentic home cooked Cypriot food in a traditional setting. If you are exploring the old town of Nicosia this is an essential spot to get a feel of how locals ate in the past. Every day of the week has a rotating set of dishes, with something vegan everyday, usually a type of bean or lentils. The prices are also great value.”

Google review
“Pork chops on the grill, mixed grill and pork chops with Orzo (Tuesday special) were amazing. Additionall, their simple undressed salad is so good and you can dress on your on on the table with EVOO, lemon and vinegar. So good olives too”

Google review
“That perfect rustic local that’s been around for generations. Excellent local cuisine, fresh and changing daily.”
